creators.name: Dr Leslie Tay (ieatishootipost)
creators.followers: Award-winning Singapore food blog since 2006 + YouTube channel

attach.note: Dr Leslie Tay, one of Singapore's most established food bloggers, wrote up the Toh sisters' Hakka suan pan zi (abacus seeds) at Shunfu Mart — 'a texture like no other'.
ieatishootipost documented the Bishan-born zi char brand and its award-winning lobster chee cheong fun when it opened a second branch.
